Game Overview

In Resize Mahjong, the core idea is straightforward: uncover animal pairs in a mahjong twist where tile sizes and shapes vary. Strategically match identical animals, considering the unique, artistic tile designs. As complexity rises, plan moves to clear the board, keeping larger tiles in check. Enjoy an enduring puzzle experience suitable for all ages.
